possibilities.title: Banks can serve local coding models from one desk machine to thin laptops
possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-12 Magpie suggested banks give developers local coding agents on ordinary machines with auditable code; Omarchy 4.6 now lets a laptop call a model on another machine over Tailscale with each request checked by the desktop's key, and the DavidAU Qwen3.8 27B merge shows strong demand for coding-tuned local models, so one strong machine can serve a whole team.

appearances.title: Omarchy 4.6 lets a laptop use a home desktop's local model over the network
appearances.summary: Omarchy 4.6 adds a way for a laptop to send prompts to a local model running on the user's own desktop, with no cloud or API bill, and the video walks through a three-step setup. Repliers describe running similar setups over Tailscale, and the account says per-request keys and wake-on-LAN are the open details.
